headline: Congress named a Stafford, Texas post office building after Leonard Scarcella, with no change to postal rules or services.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 4110 Bluebonnet Drive in Stafford, Texas, as the Leonard Scarcella Post Office Building. It is an honorary designation. It does not change how the post office operates, what services it offers, or what it costs to use.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 27, 2022, and the designation took effect on that date.
